hubTrigger.claim: Labor Day domestic trips reached 274m, about 19% above 2019, while total tourism spending was only about 0.7% above 2019.

causalNeighborhood: When trip volume recovers much faster than spend per trip, throughput-linked infrastructure with high fixed costs may capture operating leverage more directly than discretionary travel retailers, hotels or destination spending.

candidates.name: 白云机场

evidence.claim: Q1 revenue RMB1.359bn +9.71%, attributable profit turned positive to RMB44.7m, operating cash flow RMB251.9m +41.65%.
2023E net profit RMB649m and PE about 57.8x; international passenger recovery and duty-free income recovery were already central expectations.

risks: international traffic still below pre-pandemic levels
non-aeronautical/duty-free economics depend on spend, not only passenger count

evidence.claim: Q1 revenue +39.99% but attributable loss remained RMB107.9m.
